# @trysac/promise-timeouts

> Promise timeouts and cancellation utilities built on `AbortSignal`, with injectable timers, a cancellable `sleep`, `raceAbort`, and a manual clock for deterministic tests. ESM TypeScript library for Node.js 20+ with no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage and public API
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, timeline and effort metrics
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and not defended limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Vitest suites in `test/` and what they cover
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): used and discarded tools

## Optional

- [README API section](README.md#api): `withTimeout`, `sleep`, `raceAbort`, `ManualTimers`, `Timers`, `TimeoutsError`
